title: KARU KALLE JA JÄNES JULIA LIIVALOSS

characters.name: KARU KALLE
characters.description: SUUR PRUUN KARU, KES KANNAB SINIST TRIIBULIST T-SÄRKI JA LÜHIKESI ROHELISI PÜKSE. TAL ON SÕBRALIK NÄGU JA TA ON ALATI ABIVALMIS. ARMAS MULTIFILMISTIIL.

characters.name: JÄNES JULIA
characters.description: VÄIKE VALGE JÄNES, KES KANNAB ROOSAT SEELIKUT JA KOLLAST MÜTSIKEST. TAL ON PIKAD KÕRVAD JA VÄGA RÕÕMUS NÄGU. ARMAS MULTIFILMISTIIL.

locations.name: RAND
locations.description: Sunny sandy beach with a calm blue ocean in the background. Gentle waves lap at the shore. There are a few scattered seashells on the sand. Bright blue sky with a few fluffy white clouds. The atmosphere is peaceful and joyful. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Karu Kalle and Jänes Julia are standing on a sunny sandy beach near the calm blue ocean. Kalle is looking at the sand, and Julia is pointing towards it with a happy expression. The sky is bright blue with fluffy white clouds. Karu Kalle wears a blue striped t-shirt and green shorts. Jänes Julia wears a pink skirt and yellow cap.

Karu Kalle and Jänes Julia are standing on the sunny sandy beach. Kalle is holding a small blue bucket and Julia is holding a small red shovel. They are both looking at the sand with excited expressions, ready to start. The calm blue ocean is in the background. Karu Kalle wears a blue striped t-shirt and green shorts. Jänes Julia wears a pink skirt and yellow cap.

Karu Kalle is kneeling on the sunny sandy beach, scooping wet sand into his blue bucket with his hands. Jänes Julia is standing next to him, using her red shovel to push sand towards the bucket. They are working together. The calm blue ocean is in the background. Karu Kalle wears a blue striped t-shirt and green shorts. Jänes Julia wears a pink skirt and yellow cap.

Karu Kalle is carefully patting down a sand wall, making it taller. Jänes Julia is standing beside him, observing with an attentive expression. A small part of the sandcastle's base with sturdy walls is now visible on the sunny sandy beach. The calm blue ocean is in the background. Karu Kalle wears a blue striped t-shirt and green shorts. Jänes Julia wears a pink skirt and yellow cap.

Karu Kalle is gently placing a small sand bucket upside down to form a tower for the sandcastle. Jänes Julia is excitedly pointing at the growing sandcastle, which now has some walls and one small tower. They are on the sunny sandy beach. The calm blue ocean is in the background. Karu Kalle wears a blue striped t-shirt and green shorts. Jänes Julia wears a pink skirt and yellow cap.

Karu Kalle is carefully placing a small seashell onto the sandcastle wall. Jänes Julia is kneeling next to the sandcastle, holding another colorful seashell, ready to place it. The sandcastle now has several walls and towers, and a few seashells are already decorating it. They are on the sunny sandy beach. The calm blue ocean is in the background. Karu Kalle wears a blue striped t-shirt and green shorts. Jänes Julia wears a pink skirt and yellow cap.

Karu Kalle and Jänes Julia are standing back slightly from their almost finished sandcastle on the sunny sandy beach. The sandcastle is now fully decorated with seashells and looks impressive with multiple towers and walls. Kalle is smiling, and Julia is clapping her hands with joy. The calm blue ocean is in the background. Karu Kalle wears a blue striped t-shirt and green shorts. Jänes Julia wears a pink skirt and yellow cap.

Karu Kalle and Jänes Julia are standing next to their beautiful sandcastle, both smiling broadly and looking at each other. Their sandcastle stands proudly behind them on the sunny sandy beach. The calm blue ocean is in the background. Karu Kalle wears a blue striped t-shirt and green shorts. Jänes Julia wears a pink skirt and yellow cap.

Karu Kalle and Jänes Julia are admiring their sandcastle from a slight distance. Kalle has his arm around Julia's shoulder, and they both look very proud of their creation. The sandcastle is big and impressive on the sunny sandy beach. The calm blue ocean is in the background. Karu Kalle wears a blue striped t-shirt and green shorts. Jänes Julia wears a pink skirt and yellow cap.

Karu Kalle and Jänes Julia are sitting happily on the sand next to their sandcastle. Julia is holding Kalle's hand, and both have wide, joyful smiles, looking at their masterpiece. The sun is shining brightly over the calm blue ocean. Karu Kalle wears a blue striped t-shirt and green shorts. Jänes Julia wears a pink skirt and yellow cap.
